missions.name: Hubble Space Telescope
missions.summary: Pointing and jitter from HST observation logs (_jit 3-second averages + _jif summaries).
missions.time_basis: seconds since exposure start (jit 'Seconds', 3 s averages)
missions.train_label: Isolation Forest on jitter windows (split by exposure)
missions.evaluate: alert counts and reviewed outcomes (no verified fault labels)

dataset.next_action: Prepare once on a machine with the source data: python -m spaceml.missions.prepare hubble --from <folder of *_jit.fits / *_jif.fits>  (or --download <dataset ids>)

fields.name: files
fields.label: HST observation-log files or rootnames
fields.placeholder: e.g. abcd01xyj_jit.fits abcd01xyj_jif.fits  (or just the rootname)
fields.help: Find them in the MAST Portal: search your HST observation, open its products and filter for 'jit' / 'jif'.

missions.name: James Webb Space Telescope
missions.summary: Fine Guidance Sensor POINTING tables (FG / TRACK cal products): jitter and two-axis offsets per visit.
missions.time_basis: UTC from POINTING Time units (MJD days, or relative seconds/milliseconds anchored to the file stamp)
missions.train_label: Isolation Forest on jitter windows (split by visit)
missions.evaluate: alert counts and reviewed outcomes (no verified fault labels)
